headline: I research the subject. Plan the shoot. Lead the edit and the team.
intro: I set the visual direction, brief the team and stay involved through delivery. Reach, retention and how the work gets made all matter. I turn audience and brand research into positioning, campaigns, scripts and briefs.

statistics.label: Views in one month
statistics.detail: From 2.5K views, following in-house content I scripted, shot, rendered and edited.

statistics.label: Viewership growth
statistics.detail: Training the team to script and edit around audience behaviour.

statistics.label: Growth in monthly views
statistics.detail: The increase from 2.5K to 5.2M views in one month.

statistics.label: Team managed
statistics.detail: Setting priorities, training editors and maintaining quality across the team.

statistics.label: Post-production budgets
statistics.detail: Overseeing efficient use of budgets across projects of very different scales.

stories.title: Research, scripting, shooting and post.
stories.text: I scripted, shot, rendered and edited in-house content, built the explainer format and visual identity, and led 3D marketing campaigns. Competition and audience research informed the creative direction.

stories.title: Running a four-person team.
stories.text: I trained teammates to script and edit around social viewing habits, while managing a four-person team across brand, event and film campaigns. The work balanced turnaround, quality and platform fit.

stories.title: Setting direction for the channel.
stories.text: At BuzzFeed I set edit and visual direction for high-reach YouTube work and guided junior editors. At Creator Engine I shape editorial structure and AI shot priorities, reviewing work against each channel’s retention goals.

selected.title: Highlights
selected.summary: Creative direction, shooting, editing, AI, VFX and team management across film, campaigns and digital content. Project roles are shown where documented. Brand positioning, creative strategy, research and production briefs connect the work from the first idea to delivery.
selected.focus: Direction · Shooting · Editing · AI · VFX · Teams

trailers.title: Film
trailers.summary: Trailer and teaser campaigns shaped around story, tension and reveal. Editorial structure, visual treatment and sound work together to earn the next moment. Audience positioning and release strategy guide what each trailer promises and when it reveals it.

brands.title: Campaigns
brands.summary: From a brand’s visual identity to the final cut: campaign direction, editing, motion design and 3D, adapted to the platform and the audience. Positioning, customer objections, creative testing, CAC and ROAS inform the next campaign brief.

short-form.title: Short form
short-form.summary: Immediate hooks, controlled pacing and distinctive images. AI-generated shots, compositing and lip-sync extend the ideas that can be made on a short-form schedule. Audience insight, hook writing and format tests shape the brief before the cut.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.summary: Editorial structure that carries a viewer from the opening hook to the payoff. Long-form entertainment, interviews and food content, with pacing and visual identity built for the channel. Topic research, titles, thumbnails and recurring formats connect the channel strategy to the edit.

events.title: Live & comedy
events.summary: Comedy that keeps its timing. Festival and stand-up work that preserves the performance, builds anticipation and carries the energy into the campaign. Audience, rollout and production briefs connect the performance to the campaign.

source: 00_Prantik_Dutta_Creative_Strategist_PostProducer_Editor_CV.pdf, supplied October 2026. Career outcomes are owner-reported in the résumé; public video counters are separate dated snapshots.
